Implemented stabilization in linalg.rs; handed ownership to cpu_parallelism.

  • Actual SiC operator condition estimate: approximately 3.7e45 → 185 after equilibration. Native absorption now agrees with three independent scaling methods.
  • Normal solves and Hermitian adjoints retain correct implicit derivatives. Ordinary operators avoid scratch allocation; extreme column scaling has a regression test.
  • Three Rust tests and Clippy pass on final source. The preceding release passed 37 Python conditioning/linalg tests; final source needs inclusion in the shared release build.

Files changed: crates/treams-core/src/linalg.rs, new tests/test_conditioning.py. No commits, pushes, or remote synchronization.

Two actionable findings:

  • Incorrect negative-stride inputs: tmatrix.rs:49 treats reversed Fortran columns as ordinary Fortran storage. Live reproduction silently returned columns in the wrong order. Require positive Fortran layout before the fast copy.
  • Unexpected thread initialization: linalg.rs:157 initializes Rayon even for explicit sequential execution. Return Par::Seq before querying Rayon.

Selected-illumination adjoints, block indexing, ownership, context validation, and shared full-cluster assembly otherwise look correct. Read-only review; only a tiny reproduction ran.
